{{Short description|Polish mathematician (1938–2025)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=January 2025}}
'''Zdzisław Skupień''' (27 November 1938 – 1 January 2025) was a Polish mathematician, expert in [[optimization]], [[discrete mathematics]], and [[graph theory]], academic, and [[Habilitation|dr. hab.]] (1982).<ref name=wnios>[http://www.wms.agh.edu.pl/nauka/wniosek.doc Wniosek o przyznanie uprawnienia do nadawania stopnia doktora habilitowanego w dziedzinie nauk matematycznych dyscyplina: matematyka Wydziałowi Matematyki Stosowanej Akademii Górniczo-Hutniczej] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101205162921/http://www.wms.agh.edu.pl/nauka/wniosek.doc |date=5 December 2010 }} (retrieved 29 August 2012)</ref><ref>[http://nauka-polska.pl/dhtml/raporty/ludzieNauki?rtype=opis&objectId=36328&lang=pl Skupień's profile] at the "Polish Science" portal</ref><ref>[http://home.agh.edu.pl/~skupien/menueng.htm Zdzisław Skupień home page] at the Akademia Górniczo-Hutnicza, Krakow</ref><ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=60385}}</ref>

Skupień was born in [[Świlcza]], Poland.<ref name=wnios/> In 1964, Skupień introduced the concept of "locally [[Hamiltonian graph]]s".<ref name=wnios/><ref>Z. Skupień, "O pewnej charakteryzacji grafów płaskich" ("On a certain characterization of planar graphs"), PhD thesis, defended at Jagiellonian University, Krakow, on 29 September 1964.</ref>

In 1976, Skupień introduced the concept of "homogeneously traceable graphs".<ref>Skupien, Z., Homogeneously Traceable and Hamiltonian Connected Graphs, manuscript (1976), as credited in: [[Ronald J. Gould]],  "Graph Theory", Benjamin/Cummings Publishing Co., Menlo Park, CA, 1988.</ref>

Skupień authored over 140 publications.<ref name=wnios/> He died on 1 January 2025, at the age of 86.<ref>{{cite web |title=Zdzisław Skupień |url=https://www.afterall.com/obituaries/d-18930839/zdzisaw-skupie/january-2025 |website=Afterall |access-date=2 January 2025}}</ref>

==Awards==
* 1998: [[Medal of the Commission of National Education|Medal of the  Commission for National Education]] (Medal Komisji Edukacji Narodowej) <ref name=wnios/>
* 1988: [[Order of Polonia Restituta]] (Krzyż Kawalerski Orderu Odrodzenia Polski)<ref name=wnios/>
* 1983: [[Cross of Merit (Poland)|Cross of Merit]] (Złoty Krzyż Zasługi)<ref name=wnios/>
